items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: Art Roup, primarily. ... A1 Distributors was owned by Art Roup surreptitiously. ... Art didn't let him. Art didn't live up to his end of the thing.

ctx.x: Well, I knew Larry McKinley, but I thought maybe some others that I...

Well, I don't know for sure. A couple of minor players. Not minor players in the sense of who they were, but minor players on the business side of it. But to get back to what we were talking about, Joe finally succumbed to his understanding, his understanding that he'd been immensely cheated by a couple of major players. Art Roup, primarily.
